text.en:
OFFICIAL GAZETTE
financially capable of implementing the provisions of the
Minimum Wage Law and at the same time providing for
all the statutory obligations and ordinary essential services
of a regular municipality.
Done in the City of Manila, this 30th day of September,
in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and fifty-three,
and of the Independence of the Philippines, the eighth.
ELPIDIO QUIRINO
President of the Philippines
3769
By the President:
MARCIANO ROQUE
Acting Executive Secretary
